counting: an entry counts only if primary, Drosophila melanogaster, grade A or B, second read done and agrees

decision_rules.D1: graded-unit candidate: graded evidence and no spiking evidence for the group (both -> CONFLICTING)
decision_rules.D2: parameter replacement: measured Dmel value at grade A/B with n >= 1
decision_rules.D3: synaptic sign/kinetics/graded release at grade A/B
decision_rules.D4: gap junctions recorded; usable only with a connectivity source
decision_rules.D5: target: grade A/B, reproducible stimulus, quantitative readout

expectations.X1: no grade A physiology for E1/E2/I1
expectations.X2: grade A/B evidence that some nerve-cord interneuron class is graded
expectations.X3: leg MN intrinsic or recruitment data exist

grades.A: published cell matched to a connectome type present in the network
grades.B: stated hemilineage or class present in the network

interpretation_limits: Public literature only; paywalled papers at abstract level.
AI reviewer using web tools; extraction errors mitigated by a separate second read; prior knowledge may bias noticing, guarded by declared queries, stop rule and full log.
Grade C evidence never decides alone.
Identity mapping depends on published type names.
No engine change; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).

labels.EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_VARIANT: a D1 candidate, D2 or D3 entry, and >= 2 D5 targets
labels.INCONCLUSIVE: invalid entries, duplicate ids, unchecked entries or an incomplete search log

second_read: each included entry is re-read against its source by a separate reader that did not do the extraction
snowball: references and citing papers of each included primary source, one level deep
sources: public pages only, read-only; abstract-level where only the abstract is public; no downloads without the user OK; no personal data in queries
stop_rule: per question: declared queries + one-level snowball, or 25 included sources, whichever first
